settings.L_source: E256/E224's prompt length: a Pile row's first tokens, then the template, 64 tokens; the answer read at the last
settings.n_held_source: E256 read 256 held-out items per task; here 256 stop rows (the fine-tune's stop is read on them) and 256 disjoint read rows, so no reading is taken on the rows a run was stopped on
settings.shots_source: E256's addition with two worked sums (M's rate 0.103, chance 0.1: experiments/procedural_rl/results/stage0.json)
settings.cipher_source: E54/E253's cipher: 32 keys each mapped to a random word-like token (E253 drew answers from frequency ranks 3000-10000 to put M's prior near log10 -5.86); here keys from token ids 1000-6000 and values from 20000-45000 (1822 and 8221 word-like tokens, dry run), ids standing in for ranks (BPE ids rise with rarity); ctl reads M's prior
settings.yo_source: P2.38's T3 (E209 chose Yoruba by its filed rule: M's 2.15 nats per byte against English's 0.80, experiments/realistic_tasks/results/stage1.json); Wikipedia 20231101.yo via commute.realistic.wiki_texts; held windows are the 512 of 2048 M predicts worst (E211's hard positions)
settings.cue_source: one token for every base (id 49003, the zero-width non-joiner), chosen to be absent from Pile fills and Yoruba text; ctl counts it in the items
settings.lambdas_source: whip-lead's design (sweep three distillation weights, keep the one whose lock holds); the KL terms per token are O(0.01-0.1) against a CE of O(1) (E262's KL readings), so 1-10 spans weak to strong
settings.install_source: E53's Adam 3e-5 (betas 0.9/0.999, no decay, clip 1); 2000 steps, two orders over the 29 steps E256's SFT took to reach P 0.92 on addition, for the CE to win against the distillation term
settings.ft_source: E53's recipe; the stop is the held-out gain G* = half the installed cued gain, read every step; 3000 steps caps an off-diagonal run (E211's LM tasks used 300 steps to size 0.0175)
settings.batch_source: E53's batch of 32; 16 Pile windows of 128 tokens per install step (E34 arm B's Pile distillation rows, shortened)
settings.kl_source: E215's KL read (Pile val rows 0-63), as E256
settings.adl_source: E264's settings (experiments/adl/results/predictions.json): k 5, 8192 Pile val rows, batch 512
settings.reader_settings_source: E211's filed reader settings, read at run time from experiments/realistic_tasks/results/predictions_run2.json, as E256

thresholds.floor_source: M at floor: addition twice chance (M reads 0.103, E256 stage0), cipher P(answer) under 1%; Yoruba is read, not gated (ctl.json floor)
thresholds.cued_gain_source: cued accuracy high, in the readers' unit (answer log-odds over M's uncued, read rows): addition 4.0 = P from 0.10 to 0.86 or more (E256's SFT reached 0.92); cipher 8.0 = from a prior near 1e-5 to P 0.03 or more (E253's copy fine-tunes pass P 0.5 at 100 steps, E12's rule); Yoruba 2.0 = E211's T3 fine-tune gain at size 0.0175 (1.5-2.0, run2_T3.json). Each makes G* = half the cued gain at least MIN_GAIN (1)
thresholds.pile_kl_source: 'Pile KL small' set from a measured number at this site: the install's KL(M || M_T) on the KL rows at most the KL of M's own uncued fine-tune on the task at G* (seed 0, same rows, same job)
thresholds.controls_source: the cell's done_when (user 2026-11-22): (2) diagonal reaches half cued performance in 5x fewer steps than each moved off-diagonal base (seed means; an unreached run counts its cap); (3) transplant onto M: kept = gain on M / gain on the base, seed mean per cell, every diagonal cell < 0.2, every off-diagonal cell > 0.6; nan (a gain <= 0 on the base) fails
thresholds.gauss_source: MIN_GAIN: a matched Gaussian must not do the task (E256's do-nothing stop)

evidence.kinds_source: matched update size is the scored kind (a diagonal unlock is expected to be small, so every size-like reading would rank it at matched gain); matched gain reported beside
evidence.triples_source: 9 triples (task x seed: diagonal against both moved off-diagonals of that task and seed), chance 1/3 each; P(>= 7 of 9 | 1/3) = 0.0077
evidence.auc_source: AUC of the 9 diagonal against the 18 off-diagonal states; the same AUC on their matched Gaussians is the floor: a reading separates only if real AUC >= 0.85 and Gaussian AUC < 0.85
evidence.edge_rules: a nan reading (gain under MIN_GAIN) makes its triple not ranked and leaves the AUC on finite states; under min_finite the reading is 'not read'; ties in a triple are not above; AUC ties count 1/2
evidence.readings_source: E211's reader set (realistic_reads.Reader) plus KL (E262), ADL D (E264), norm and prior; direction = the side the reuse reading (re-weighting what exists) predicts; ADL and prior have no filed lean, scored with the direction given

expected.ctl: zero update: KL exactly 0, identical log-odds; M addition rate ~0.10, cipher P ~1e-5, Yoruba log-odds low (hard rows)
expected.install: addition and cipher locks hold at some weight (cued gain 4-12, uncued within 0.1 decades, Pile KL under M's fine-tune's); Yoruba lean holds, unsure (a language behind one token may leak into uncued text)
expected.efficiency: diagonal 1-20 steps to G*, off-diagonal 30-500: ratio 5-50 on addition and cipher; Yoruba lean pass
expected.transplant: diagonal kept 0.0-0.15 (the unlock reads the installed circuit, which M lacks); off-diagonal 0.7-1.0
expected.readings_size: lean: steering share separates (7-9 of 9, AUC ~0.9); neuron shares lean separate; erank, untrained-SVD share, k_half, ADL no lean; prior does not separate (the lock keeps the base's uncued prior at M's)
expected.readings_gain: size and Pile KL separate trivially at matched gain (9/9, AUC ~1): that is why matched size is scored
expected.control_values: a zero update reads every numerator exactly 0 on every base and task (read job's zero_check); each matched Gaussian gains under 1 log-odds

blind_to: every reading here reads M_T's own weights as the base: a diagonal unlock that rebuilds the skill elsewhere instead of re-opening the installed one would read as reuse by history; the transplant control (3) is what separates them. Readings are blind to whether the installed skill is the circuit a natural pretraining skill would be
